tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background, slate blue. Every page sits on this; there is no light theme.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Raised panels and cards one step above bg.

tokens.name: lid
tokens.usage: Deep insets: the chip lid, button face, ticker box, photo frames.

tokens.name: board
tokens.usage: The chip's board ring around the lid.

tokens.name: sub
tokens.usage: Sub-panels and quiet fills inside panels.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers on bg.

tokens.name: line-2
tokens.usage: Stronger borders, hover outlines.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on bg, panel and lid.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Secondary light text, contest-page heroes.

tokens.name: cream-hi
tokens.usage: Brightest text: logo lettering, prize figures, button labels.

tokens.name: soft
tokens.usage: Body copy on bg (8.9:1).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Nav links, captions, meta text (5.3:1 on bg).

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: Tiny labels like 'Pin 01 · Programming'. 3.6:1 on bg: below 4.5:1, so keep it for non-essential labels or move them to muted.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: THE accent. Active pin, links on hover, dots, wires, the motto's middle stop, focus rings. 6.6:1 on bg.

tokens.name: green-hi
tokens.usage: Light green: the motto's first stop and shimmer highlights.

tokens.name: green-deep
tokens.usage: Deep green for pressed states and dark glows.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Soft green for secondary highlights.

tokens.name: rim
tokens.usage: Lit rims on panels and buttons, used at 14-30% strength.

tokens.name: on-green
tokens.usage: Text on a solid green fill.

tokens.name: pulse
tokens.usage: The brightest point of a glow or signal pulse.

tokens.name: light-0
tokens.usage: Glow ramp, centre (white-green). Bottom light and button sheen.

tokens.name: light-1
tokens.usage: Glow ramp step 1.

tokens.name: light-2
tokens.usage: Glow ramp step 2.

tokens.name: light-3
tokens.usage: Glow ramp step 3, the accent itself.

tokens.name: light-4
tokens.usage: Glow ramp step 4.

tokens.name: light-5
tokens.usage: Glow ramp step 5, teal.

tokens.name: light-6
tokens.usage: Glow ramp step 6, blue.

tokens.name: light-7
tokens.usage: Glow ramp edge, fades into bg.

tokens.name: logo-top
tokens.usage: Logo gradient, top stop (teal). The logo runs top to bottom from logo-top to logo-bottom.

tokens.name: logo-bottom
tokens.usage: Logo gradient, bottom stop (green).

styles.name: hero-title
styles.usage: The chip title. Scales down to 40px on phones.

styles.name: prize
styles.usage: Prize figures; the pool rolls like an odometer, then shimmers.

styles.name: motto
styles.sample: AI for Mankind, Society and the Sustainable Development Goals
styles.usage: The motto, filled with the green-hi, green, cream-hi gradient.

styles.name: pin-name
styles.usage: Contest names around the hero chip: cream-hi, green when active.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Ten national competitions in programming, AI, data science, research, robotics, cybersecurity, business and esports.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Nav links in muted, ink on hover.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: The smallest labels; numbers set tabular.

styles.name: ticker
styles.usage: The uppercase name ticker beside the nav logo. The only uppercase text besides the logo.

styles.name: logo-word
styles.usage: Logo lettering only. Never for headings or body text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inline gaps, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Logo to ticker; small stacks.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card inner gaps; phone side gutter minimum.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter on phones; card padding.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Page gutter on tablet and desktop.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Fixed nav bar height; heroes start below it.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Pixel dots and tiny marks.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, the name ticker, photo insets.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Photo tiles in the prize strip.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: The large hero panel.

tokens.name: shadow-button
tokens.usage: Green glow under buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-tile
tokens.usage: Photo tiles and raised cards.
